# ASSET CATALOG (generated from public/assets/manifest.json — do not edit by hand)

Every model below is CC0 (KayKit, see ASSET_LICENSES.md). Load them through `src/client/render/assets.js` (`new Assets().load()`), never by URL.
Models are in metres: characters ≈ 1.8 m tall (chunky, ~3 heads), dungeon kit modules snap to a 4 m grid (floor_tile_large = 4×4 m, floor_tile_small = 2×2 m, wall = 4 m long).

## Characters (group `chars`) — all share one 41-bone rig and ONE animation library (`anims/Rig_Medium`, 72 clips)
Bones: root, hips, spine, chest, upperarm/lowerarm/wrist/hand/handslot (.l/.r), head, upperleg/lowerleg/foot/toes (.l/.r) + IK helpers.
Attach points: `handslot.r`, `handslot.l` (weapons — note GLTFLoader strips dots from node names; `CharacterRig.attach` handles it), `head`, `chest`.
Built-in meshes per character (all variants ship inside the file; `rig.equip([...names])` shows only the chosen ones; the rest of the body parts are always visible):
- **Knight**: 1H_Sword_Offhand@handslot.l, Badge_Shield@handslot.l, Rectangle_Shield@handslot.l, Round_Shield@handslot.l, Spike_Shield@handslot.l, 1H_Sword@handslot.r, 2H_Sword@handslot.r, Knight_Helmet@head, Knight_Cape@chest, Knight_ArmLeft, Knight_ArmRight, Knight_Body, Knight_Head, Knight_LegLeft, Knight_LegRight
